description: Na₄Bi₂O₅ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. There are four inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to four O atoms to form NaO₄ trigonal pyramids that share corners with two equivalent NaO₄ trigonal pyramids, edges with two equivalent NaO₅ square pyramids, and  an edgeedge with one NaO₄ trigonal pyramid. There are three shorter (2.32 Å) and one longer (2.34 Å) Na-O bond length. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted see-saw-like geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.36-2.48 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded to five O atoms to form distorted NaO₅ square pyramids that share corners with two equivalent NaO₄ trigonal pyramids,  an edgeedge with one NaO₅ square pyramid, and edges with two equivalent NaO₄ trigonal pyramids. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.45-2.59 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded to four O atoms to form distorted NaO₄ trigonal pyramids that share corners with two equivalent NaO₅ square pyramids, corners with two equivalent NaO₄ trigonal pyramids, and edges with two NaO₄ trigonal pyramids. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.33-2.50 Å. There are two inequivalent Bi sites. In the first Bi site, Bi is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of Bi-O bond distances ranging from 2.09-2.19 Å. In the second Bi site, Bi is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of Bi-O bond distances ranging from 2.10-2.15 Å. There are five inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to five Na and one Bi atom to form distorted ONa₅Bi octahedra that share  a cornercorner with one ONa₃Bi trigonal pyramid, edges with two equivalent ONa₅Bi octahedra, edges with three equivalent ONa₄Bi square pyramids, and  an edgeedge with one ONa₃Bi trigonal pyramid. In the second O site, O is bonded to four Na and one Bi atom to form ONa₄Bi square pyramids that share corners with three equivalent ONa₃Bi trigonal pyramids and edges with three equivalent ONa₅Bi octahedra. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and one Bi atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded to three Na and one Bi atom to form distorted ONa₃Bi trigonal pyramids that share  a cornercorner with one ONa₅Bi octahedra, corners with three equivalent ONa₄Bi square pyramids, and  an edgeedge with one ONa₅Bi octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 67°. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two Na and two Bi atoms.
